implementation.retention: gpui/element.go + gpui/render.go + gpui/key_dispatch.go: the frame records every accessed element-state key (window.rs accessed_element_states), and the frame-end retention carries over exactly those keys (Frame::finish's loop), so a stopped element's state drops and removal-followed-by-reinsertion starts fresh; the frame publication is success-gated — an abandoned build (a returned error OR a panicking element build) preserves the prior published frame (scene, debug bounds, inline facts, dispatch tree, draw counter) through a completion flag, and the failed frame's dispatch tree is discarded without swapping the rendered state; application mutations made during the failed build are never rolled back.
